items.cap:
This is Mr. Bernal.
His name is Luis.
He is the father.
He is Mrs. Bernal’s husband.

This is Mrs. Bernal.
Her name is Cecilia.
She is the mother.
She is Mr. Bernal’s wife.

blocks.text: They have four children: Cecilia, Luis Jr., Carolina, and Gustavo. They have two daughters and two sons.

items.cap:
Cecilia is 19 years old.
She studies at the university.

Luis Jr. is 18 years old.
He studies high school.

Carolina is 12 years old.
She is also in high school.

Gustavo is 9 years old.
He is in 4th grade.

blocks.text: Cecilia and Carolina are Luis and Gustavo’s sisters. Gustavo and Luis are Cecilia and Carolina’s brothers.

items.cap:
This is Hector.
He is their uncle.
He is Mr. Bernal’s brother.

This is Teresa.
She is their aunt.
She is Hector’s wife.

blocks.text: Cecilia and Carolina are Hector and Teresa’s nieces. Luis Jr. and Gustavo are Hector’s and Teresa’s nephews.
Hector and Teresa have two daughters, Diana and María Teresa. They are cousins of Carolina, Cecilia, Gustavo, and Luis Jr.

items.cap:
This is Cotton.
It is a beautiful dog.
It is their pet.

This is Dolores.
She is Mrs. Bernal’s mother.
She is their grandmother, too.

This is Gustavo Bernal.
He is Mr. Bernal’s father.
He is a chemical engineer.

This is María Isabel.
She is their grandmother.
She is Mr. Bernal’s mother.
